case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We ordered from you at EUR 339.37 per unit in 2024-09 and at EUR 348.32 per unit in 2026-09 (po:4500011414-10, po:4500014474-10). On that basis we propose EUR 343.47 per unit, payment 90 days net, a fixed price without an index clause.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While we value our reliable cooperation, we cannot revert to historical price levels under current market conditions. 

Our offer stands at a price of €373.97 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, under our standard terms, we offer a price of €369.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We are willing to revise our offer to €369.85 per unit, provided we maintain the 30-day payment terms, as extending to 90 days would require a higher unit price. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

thank you for your reply and for moving towards us. Our forecast fc:350011@2026-09 expects 6,110 units a year, a change of +11.9 %. We can improve our proposal to EUR 349.75 per unit, payment 90 days net, a fixed price without an index clause. Could you meet us there?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have verified your forecast of 6,110 units and have factored this volume increase into our calculation. While we appreciate your movement, our cost structure does not permit us to meet your proposed price level for extended payment terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We can therefore offer a revised price of €372.03 per unit, maintaining the 90-day payment terms you requested. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is a price of €372.03 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
